places.name: Blue Duck's camp on the Canadian
places.note: Lorena is held and abused in a filthy camp near a creek; Blue Duck kills a young Kiowa while gambling and sends Ermoke to ambush Gus.
places.location_hint: on the open plains along the Canadian River in the Texas Panhandle, near a creek; Gus is expected to come down the river from the west

places.name: Canadian River
places.note: The men complain they are stranded on it without horses; Blue Duck expects Gus to come down it.

places.name: Quitaque
places.note: Blue Duck says his pursuer wandered off across it before figuring out the trail.
places.location_hint: Texas Panhandle, southeast of Palo Duro Canyon

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Lorena recalls hiding her words there but finding them readily when Jake arrived.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

groups.label: Kiowa ambush party
groups.hint: left camp at dawn to find help and ambush Gus coming down the river
